featured_reviews.name: Gaurang Morarka
featured_reviews.review_text:
Near-expired stock, unethical sales practices and zero accountability. Avoid!

Terrible experience at the Noble’s Khar West branch. I am extremely disappointed with the service at this Wellness Forever branch and would like to warn other customers about my experience.

I have been ordering medicines from this store for more than 2 years. Recently, I have been facing repeated service issues from this particular branch.

On 04-06-2026 at around 8:23 PM, I called the store as I usually do to place an order. I shared my prescription details, contact number, and delivery address. The staff confirmed that the medicine was available in stock and assured me that it would be delivered.

However, even after 24 hours, nobody called me or updated me regarding the order. When I called back on 05-06-2026 at around 8:55 PM to check the status, I was shocked to be informed that no order had been placed at all.

To make matters worse:

• The staff could not locate my prescription.
• The staff was unable to identify the medicine correctly and repeatedly mentioned the wrong medicine name.
• The staff kept asking me to send the details again on WhatsApp despite already having shared everything earlier.

This level of negligence is completely unacceptable, especially when dealing with medicines that customers may urgently require. Wellness Forever is a well-known brand, but the poor service and lack of staff competency at this branch are seriously damaging its reputation.

I request Wellness Forever management to take strict action and provide proper training to the staff of this branch.

I would also advise fellow customers to be cautious while ordering medicines from this branch. The staff appears incapable of handling orders accurately, which may lead to delays or confusion regarding medicines. Additionally, the delivery service is extremely slow and, in my experience, orders are rarely delivered early minimum 2 hours to deliver at a 10 mins location.

Very disappointing experience.

featured_reviews.review_text: As a tourist, this was the first shop I entered in India. I had some urgent needs and bought a few necessary items here. featured_reviews.name: Rashida Sharafally
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had purchased Midazolam Nasal Spray from General Medical(Colaba) on 31st Dec 2024 since my dad was getting epileptic seizures on stop on that day. Since we were in a hurry, we didn't wait for the bill which was our bad luck.  Unfortunately my dad passed on 08 Jan 2025. I went to General Medical last week to return the nasal spray which has not been opened only to be told that they won't accept the medicine since it was an open box. I was quite taken by surprise at their attitude. The medicine has their sticker with the price on it. This is the first time that I have been told that a medicine sold in a box can not be returned. A chemist called Mukesh told me outright that he wouldn't take it. An extremely rude man. I told him that I was returning it unopened since my father had passed. It didn't even remotely make a difference. Mukesh knew he was wrong and when I asked him his last name he didn't divulge the same. I went there around 4.30 pm and when I asked for the manager he lied and told me that he has gone for lunch. The strangest thing is that my late father was a regular over there and even that did not make any difference to that obnoxious man.

A STRONG MESSAGE TO GENERAL MEDICAL - YOUR PEOPLE NEED TO BE A BIT MORE SENSITIVE TO CUSTOMERS. IF A CUSTOMER HAS NOT UTILISED ANY MEDICINE AND WISHES TO RETURN IT EVEN WITHOUT A BILL, YOU NEED TO TAKE IT BACK ESPECIALLY IF YOUR COMPANY'S STICKER IS ON THE BOX.

featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐ 1 Star Review – Wellness Forever Pharmacy, Colaba Division

I had a very bad experience at this store. On 5th September, I purchased medicines after showing my doctor’s prescription. The staff packed the medicines, and I trusted them. But when I reached home and opened the packet, I found they had given me wrong medicines.

I immediately called the pharmacy, but my calls were ignored. The next day, I personally visited the shop and informed the staff about the mistake. They admitted it was their error and promised to provide the correct medicine on 7th September. When I visited again, I was told the medicine had not come and was asked to come back on 8th or 9th.

Finally, I sent my colleague on 10th September night at 11 PM to collect the medicine since I was not in Colaba. Shockingly, the wrong medicine was given again. Even after calling them multiple times, they cut my calls and did not respond properly.

Later, my staff again visited the shop around midnight, and I spoke with the staff on the phone. At first, they refused a refund, but after a long argument they finally refunded my money.

This whole experience was pathetic and irresponsible. Providing wrong medicine is not a small mistake—it is dangerous for patients’ health. Staff here do not take responsibility, do not answer calls, and are careless while handling prescriptions.

⚠️ I strongly advise people to be very careful if you buy from this store. Always double-check the medicines they give you. In my opinion, it is better to go to any of the many other pharmacies in Colaba where staff are responsible and professional.
